summary: Frontend-only mobile (390x844) regression + new feature test for Analytics Pelanggan (index.tsx) and new Produk tab (produk.tsx). Pelanggan regression passed fully (header/tabs, period picker, trend/segment/region cards, bottom nav, no tap-tooltips). Produk tab renders correctly with all 4 cards, correct data (Ketersediaan 118/28/10=156, Perputaran 72/61/23=156), consistent visual system with Pelanggan. Cross-navigation Pelanggan<->Produk repeated 3x did not crash or freeze. One state-persistence issue found: each screen's selected month resets to default 'Sep 2026' every time you navigate away and back (component unmount via router.replace clears local useState), instead of remembering the last month picked on that specific tab.

integration_issues.flow: Pelanggan <-> Produk tab navigation with period selection
integration_issues.issue: Selected month is NOT preserved when switching tabs and coming back. Steps: Pelanggan picker set to Apr 2026 -> switch to Produk (shows Sep 2026, OK, independent state) -> Produk picker set to Jun 2026 -> switch back to Pelanggan: expected 'Apr 2026' but shows 'Sep 2026' (reset). Switch to Produk again: expected 'Jun 2026' but shows 'Sep 2026' (reset). Root cause: both app/index.tsx and app/produk.tsx initialize selectedMonth via local useState('2026-09'), and router.replace() fully unmounts the leaving screen and remounts the target screen, wiping local state. Each screen is technically independent (no cross-contamination) but neither screen's own selection survives a round trip, which contradicts the 'separately-stored month selection' expectation in the requirements.

action_items: Lift selectedMonth state for both tabs to a shared parent/context/global store (e.g. Zustand, or a shared layout-level state in _layout.tsx) so each tab's chosen month persists across navigation round-trips, OR use router.push + keep both screens mounted, OR persist via a simple module-level/AsyncStorage state keyed per tab.
Decide if this is in-scope for this round; flagging since agent_to_agent_context_note implies 'separately-stored month selection' should persist, not just be non-interfering.
critical_code_review_comments: app/index.tsx and app/produk.tsx are near-duplicate files (shared styles, Header, nav, layout markup ~90% identical). Acceptable for this dummy-data MVP scope but flagged as a DRY violation risk for future maintenance -- consider extracting shared shell (Header, BottomNav, styles) into a common component.

Data integrity verified: Ketersediaan Produk (118+28+10=156) and Perputaran Produk (72+61+23=156) totals match donut center label '156 produk' for Sep 2026 snapshot, and recompute correctly for Jun 2026 (103+24+9=136, matches donut center '136 produk' seen in screenshot).
No MongoDB/backend involved as expected (pure dummy data), no _id leakage concerns.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% - all UI/data/navigation checks passed except month-persistence-across-navigation issue

seed_data_creation: None; used existing local dummy snapshots in analyticsData.ts / productData.ts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified at https://ummu-bos-app.preview.emergentagent.com with 390x844 viewport. Confirmed: Pelanggan tab visuals/data unchanged (Tren 13/15/17/16/19/21, Segmentasi 15/4/2/3/4 = 28, Sebaran 8 regions), Produk tab new cards render correctly with matching design tokens (card radius/padding, section icon bubble, legend/turnover row style, bottom nav). PeriodPicker disabled-month dimming confirmed (Jan opacity ~0.32). Tapping segment rows shows no popup (as required). The ONLY issue found is month-selection not persisting across tab switches -- both tabs always reset to 'Sep 2026' default on remount. This is a state-management issue (useState + router.replace remount), not a data/visual bug. Everything else matches the requirements exactly.
